newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end mixed, ignore rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end mixed, ignore rate cut.

text.p: Shares closed mixed with some signs that profit-taking, which began on Thursday, could resume on Monday, traders said.

*Traders had forecast a weak session for Friday but the strong close of New York, the firmness of the dollar and the performance of other European bourse had helped to sustain the market at the start. But it later lost ground.
*"The market closed "seller" and we could see it correct some more on Monday," said one trader who asked not to be identified.

*Traders said that the Bank of Portugal's 30 basis point cut in rates had been largely ignored because the market had already discounted the fact that local interest rates would fall further this year.
*"The declines of these past couple of days are natural after the rise of last week which was probably too much, too fast," added another trader.
*The PSI20 index ended 0.41 percent down at 7,940.59.
